reference.title: tagdictionary-IsType
reference.shortdesc: IsType is one of several possible validity conditions subproperties, which are used to specify a certain criteria to be met in order for a tag to be applied to an object.

section.p: If the queried object is of the specified object type, then the parent definition's tag(s) may be applied.
The validity conditions are located in the tagdictionary palette.
